additional_info.subject: RE: ID0421350-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / N0 160382404 ERK] Charging Issue CRM:02698000079
additional_info.body:
Hello Rudi,
Hope you are doing well.
Upon reviewing the system logs corresponding to the reported timestamps, we observed that no remote start command was issued, nor was any RFID card tapped to authorize the charging session. As a result, while the AC charger outlet was physically connected to the vehicle, the charging process did not initiate due to the absence of proper session authorization.
Please let us know if you have any further questions or if we may proceed with closing the ticket
.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar

additional_info.subject: RE: AW: ID0421350-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / N0 160382404 ERK] Charging Issue CRM:02698000079
additional_info.body:
Dear Mr. Hofmann,
I hope you're doing well.
To initiate the charging session, please follow these steps:
Connect the charging cable
to your electric vehicle. Ensure that the connection is secure.
Once the vehicle and charging station establish communication and the cable is properly latched,
start the session either via:
RFID authentication
using a registered RFID card.
Remote start
through your backend system, mobile app.
Please ensure that your charging station is online and authorized to start sessions through your selected method.
Should you need further support or clarification, feel free to contact us.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
